title: The Unreachable Threshold

features.name: the receding gateway
features.desc-on-touch: a doorway that becomes smaller the closer you approach—each step forward pushes it further away, a geometric paradox that refutes approach

features.name: the updating coordinates
features.desc-on-touch: numbers that change as you read them—distance: 100 becomes 200, direction shifts as you turn to follow it, a position that moves away from itself

features.name: the diagnostic readout
features.desc-on-touch: a screen showing the archive's approach-failure in real time: distance increasing, angle resolving nowhere, a record of the threshold's refusal

features.name: the horizon line
features.desc-on-touch: where sky becomes question—the place you are moving toward but cannot reach, rendered in the moment before arrival erases the approach

inscription: come closer and the answer recedes; stop still and the question approaches—the threshold learns from both motions
